title: Rung 1: LLVM18-compatible Rust and Julia frontends required
description:
The requested dual-major scalar rung includes Rust and Julia on LLVM18, never an omitted language. Installed rustc 1.99.1 emits LLVM23.1.1; Julia 1.13.3 code_llvm emits LLVM20.1.8. All source native O0/O2 oracles compile/run, but LLVM18 cannot read their current stock IR. Dialect @023f5a7 §19.8: "An input newer than M is BD-E-VERSION." This is a toolchain prerequisite, not an illegal scalar or a plugin refusal. Install and publish compatible stock Rust/Julia frontends that emit LLVM<=18 and fit the legality envelope, with explicit paths/version recording; otherwise coordinate the frontend/major matrix with the dialect owner. Do not rewrite/downgrade IR, drop languages or count this as a skip. Reproduce commands:

/usr/lib/llvm-18/bin/llvm-link /home/tobias/Projects/bennett-workspace/bennett-conformance/.tmp/rung-1/20261101T132057.475661Z/Julia/18/ir/r1_sat_add.ll /home/tobias/Projects/bennett-workspace/bennett-conformance/.tmp/rung1-bennett-runtimes-6808622d560b2e301c635c205eecde3d932b6df5/dist/llvm18/bennett-runtimes.bc /home/tobias/Projects/bennett-workspace/bennett-conformance/.tmp/rung1-bennett-arith-249e6192b95c6dbbb875510c32a677ba113e9af5/dist/llvm18/bennett-arith.bc --only-needed -o /home/tobias/Projects/bennett-workspace/bennett-conformance/.tmp/rung-1/20261101T132057.475661Z/Julia/18/r1_sat_add/linked.bc
Observed: Invalid attribute group entry (Producer LLVM23.1.1 / Reader LLVM18.1.3); Julia getelementptr inbounds nuw: expected type. Evidence /home/tobias/Projects/bennett-workspace/bennett-conformance/.tmp/rung-1/20261101T132057.475661Z
close_reason: Orchestrator ruling 2026-11-01: not a blocker. North Star §8 rung 1 requires both executors equal to native, not both LLVM majors per language. Dialect §19.8 forbids inputs newer than M but accepts older ones, so the matrix is: C on LLVM 18 and 23 (stock clang of each major); Rust on LLVM 23 (stock rustc 1.99.1 emits 23.1.1 IR; 18 only if a stock rustc with LLVM<=18 is installed, not required); Julia on LLVM 23 (stock Julia 1.13.3 emits LLVM 20.1.8 IR, which the 23 pipeline reads). No IR downgrade, no language dropped. The rung-1 gate's matrix should be adjusted to this (mark Rust/18 and Julia/18 as 'not applicable: stock frontend emits IR newer than M (§19.8)', not FAIL); the remaining Rust/Julia blockers are the plugin beads bp-xb8 (Rust personality) and bp-zeg (Julia gcstack entry state), and bp-75y for the exhaustive full-D rows.

title: Differential harness (muse-harness stream): black-box executor comparison + generator/shrinker in harness/**
Accept audited two-stage native comparison adapter and select LLVM major in driver probe
description: bennett-driver-cyg implements --bennett-materialised/--bennett-comparison-record/output. Audited native record has bitcode_link_argv (llvm-link device.bc runtime.bc arith.bc --only-needed) and link_argv (clang same-major comparison-linked.bc and explicit native support). Direct clang of all three .bc files creates duplicate strong definitions because device.bc already links needed runtime functions; merged --only-needed preserves actual device input/hash and runtime/arith pin hashes. §19.5 layout requires an auditable linker script/map; gate whitelist currently rejects -Wl,-T, --fatal-warnings/--no-undefined and expects library paths directly in final link argv. Needed equivalent consumer adapter validating bitcode_link_argv, linked/materialised/library hashes and script/map instead of weakening no-libc checks. Also driver_probe omits --bennett-llvm-major so both gates choose newest envelope major23 by §19.8 default; pass explicit m for per-major receipts. All full R/native prerequisites remain blocked (bp-xkg, plugin comparison bead, brt-nuu); no gate or fixture narrowed.
